chapters.title: A son, held in the same hands
chapters.note: Danny I on his newborn son; Danny II on growing up in a house built around not talking.

chapters.title: Eight hours or eleven
chapters.note: Danny III's birth: his father says Danny I drove eleven hours and cried; Danny I says eight, and no tears.

chapters.title: The wings were only a loan
chapters.note: Grandpa pins his jump wings on a seven-year-old, seen by all three of them.

chapters.title: Not one deer
chapters.note: A morning in the woods before daylight. Danny II remembers it in 1982, his son in 1983.

chapters.title: The score didn't come home
chapters.note: An afternoon at the range, and three men finding out what mattered more than the target.

chapters.title: Quiet, or a long speech
chapters.note: Danny II retires after twenty-two years. He remembers going quiet; his son remembers a long speech.

chapters.title: The hill
chapters.note: A run that turned into a walk. Who went ahead depends on who is telling it.

chapters.title: Grandpa's last week
chapters.note: Danny I at eighty-three, six weeks after the towers, buried with his wings.

chapters.title: Good
chapters.note: Danny II's last week, with his son home from somewhere he couldn't name.
